excerpt.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]给养被虚空孳孽的酸性毒液污染了。
excerpt.en: Our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply has been contaminated with the acidic venom from the Voidspawn.

texts.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]给养被虚空孳孽的酸性毒液污染了。
texts.en: Our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply has been contaminated with the acidic venom from the Voidspawn.

texts.zh: 在几个月的努力后，我们在[Target.GetName]上的[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]资源终于移除了虚空孳孽污染变得清洁可用。这并不是徒劳一场，反之，我们在[Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower]中学到了许多异星生理学的基本知识，并且已经准备好继续进行[Owner.GetParadeStudy]。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为，只要[Owner.GetParadeStudy]的研究得出结果，他们就能以其提升[Target.GetName]的生活质量。
texts.en: After many months of effort, our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] supply on [Target.GetName] is finally clear of the Voidspawn Contaminant. It was not a wasted effort, as we have learned much from the xeno-biology present in our [Owner.GetWaterCoolantLower] and are now ready to proceed with the [Owner.GetParadeStudy]. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] now think that they can improve life on [Target.GetName] with the these discoveries once the [Owner.GetParadeStudy] concludes.
